allow_instructions: Read-only inspections of build artifacts under ./dist are fine.
cursor_usage with operation summary, limits, or alert_check is always allowed.
cursor_inbox with operation list or read is always allowed.
Read-only git status, log, and diff are fine.
block_instructions: Always pause delete operations, rm -rf, and Remove-Item -Recurse.
Pause docker compose down, git push, and any production deploy.
Pause file_ops write/delete and container_ops stop/remove unless explicitly approved.
Pause cursor_inbox ack_all and purge unless explicitly approved.
